question:
The population of a town is 15000. If the population increases by 15% in the first year, by 25% in the second year and due to pollution it decreases by 6% in the third year, what will be its population after 3 years?

(Round off number in answer)

(CPO 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 20269.

Population after 3 years 

\(=p\times(\frac{100+1st \space year}{100})\)\((\frac{100+2nd \space year}{100})\)\((\frac{100-3rd \space year}{100})\)

\(=15000(\frac{100+15}{100})(\frac{10+25}{100})(\frac{100-6}{100})\)

\(=15000\times\frac{115}{100}\times\frac{125}{100}\times\frac{94}{100} \)

\(=\frac{15\times115\times47}{4}\)

= 20268.78

= 20269
question_hi:
एक शहर की जनसंख्या 15000 है। यदि पहले वर्ष में जनसंख्या 15% बढ़ जाती है, दूसरे वर्ष में 25% बढ़ जाती है और प्रदूषण के कारण तीसरे वर्ष में 6% कम हो जाती है, तो 3 वर्ष बाद इसकी जनसंख्या क्या होगी?

(उत्तर में संख्या को पूर्णांकित करें)

(CPO 2024 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 यानी 20269 है।

3 वर्ष बाद जनसंख्या

 \(=p\times(\frac{100+1st \space year}{100})\) \((\frac{100+2nd \space year}{100})\)\((\frac{100-3rd \space year}{100})\)

\(=15000(\frac{100+15}{100})(\frac{10+25}{100})(\frac{100-6}{100})\)

\(=15000\times\frac{115}{100}\times\frac{125}{100}\times\frac{94}{100} \)

\(=\frac{15\times115\times47}{4}\)

=20268.78

=20269

Old population = P

P2 = 5555555.55

\(P_3\times(1+\frac{20}{100})^3=8000000\)

P3 = 4629629.63

Difference between P2 & P3

= 5555555.55 - 4629629.63 = 925925.93

question:
In a test match, a batsman scored 30% of his total runs by hitting sixes, 25% of his total runs by hitting boundaries (each boundary = 4 runs), and the rest by hitting singles and doubles. question:
Three-fourth students of a class are boys. If 120 girls are added to the class, then three-fourth students of the class would be girls. What percentage increment should be there in the girls to have 40 girls in the class?

solution:

3x         :    x

\(=\frac{25}{15}\) x 100% = 166.67%

लड़के   :   लड़कियां
3x         :    x

9x = x + 120 
8x = 120 
x = 15 
∴ प्रारंभिक लड़कियाँ = x = 15 

∴ प्रतिशत वृद्धि  \(=\frac{40-15}{15}\times 100%\)

\(=\frac{25}{15}\) x 100% = 166.67%

question:
A, B and C donate 8%, 7% and 9%, of their salaries respectively to a charitable trust. The salaries of A and B are same and the difference between their donations is ₹259. The total donation of A and B is ₹1,185 more than that of C. The total donation of A and C is what percentage of the total salaries of A, B and C? (Correct to one decimal place)

(CGL 2019 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 5.8%.

Salaries of A & B are the same.

(8% - 7%) = 1% = 259 

100% = 25900

Salary of A = Salary of B  = 25900

25900 × (8 + 7)% - C × 9%=1185 

3885 - C × 9% =1185

C × 9% = 2700 (donation by C)

C = 30000 (Salary of C)

Donation of A= 25900 × 8% = 2072

Donation of A + C = 2072 + 2700 = 4772

Total Salary of A + B + C 

= 2 × 25900 + 30000

51800 + 30000 = 81800

Required % = \(\frac{4772}{81800}\times 100\) % = 5.83%
question_hi:
A, B और C अपने वेतन का क्रमशः 8%, 7% और 9% किसी धर्मार्थ ट्रस्ट को दान करते हैं। A और B का वेतन समान है और उनके दान के बीच का अंतर ₹259 है। A और B का कुल दान, C की तुलना में ₹1,185 अधिक है। A और C का कुल दान A, B और C के कुल वेतन का कितना प्रतिशत है? (दशमलव के एक स्थान तक सही करें)

(CGL 2019 Pre)
solution_hi:

(8% - 7%) = 1% = 259

100% = 25900

A का वेतन = B का वेतन = 25900

25900 × (8 + 7)% - C × 9% = 1185

3885 - C × 9% =1185

C × 9% = 2700 (C द्वारा दान)

C = 30000 (C का वेतन)

A का दान = 25900 × 8% = 2072

A + C का दान = 2072 + 2700 = 4772

A + B + C का कुल वेतन

= 2 × 25900 + 30000

51800 + 30000 = 81800

आवश्यक % = \(\frac{4772}{81800}\times 100\) % = 5.83%

question:
A certain number of students from school X appeared in an examination and 20% students failed. From school Y, 130% more students than that from school X, appeared in the same examination. If 90% of the total number of students appeared from both the schools passed, then what is the percentage of students from school Y who failed (correct to one decimal place)?

(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 5.7%.

Let appeared students from school X = 100

Students appeared from school Y = 230

Total students from both schools appeared = 100 + 230 = 330

80% passed from school X = 80 

Now, 90% of total students passed from both schools \(=\frac{330\times90}{100}\) = 297

Students passed from school Y = 297 - 80 = 217 

Failed students from Y  = 230 - 217 = 13 

Required%=  \(\frac{13\times100}{230}\)

= 5.65 ~ 5.7%
question_hi:
किसी परीक्षा में विद्यालय X से निश्चित संख्या में छात्र उपस्थित हुए और 20% छात्र अनुत्तीर्ण हो गए। उसी परीक्षा में, विद्यालय X की तुलना में विद्यालय Y से 130% अधिक छात्र उपस्थित हुए। यदि दोनों विद्यालयों से उपस्थित हुए कुल छात्रो में से 90% छात्र उत्तीर्ण हुए, तो विद्यालय Y के अनुत्तीर्ण छात्रों का प्रतिशत (एक दशमलव स्थान तक) ज्ञात करें। 

(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 यानी 5.7 है।

माना स्कूल X से उपस्थित छात्र = 100

स्कूल Y से उपस्थित छात्र = 230

दोनों स्कूलों से उपस्थित कुल छात्र = 100 + 230 = 330

स्कूल X से 80% उत्तीर्ण = 80

अब, दोनों स्कूलों से उत्तीर्ण कुल छात्रों का 90% \(=\frac{330\times90}{100}\) = 297

स्कूल Y से उत्तीर्ण छात्र = 297 - 80 = 217

Y से अनुत्तीर्ण छात्र = 230 - 217 = 13 

अभीष्ट% =  \(\frac{13\times100}{230}\)

= 5.65 ~ 5.7%

question:
Three persons A, B and C donate 10%, 7% and 9% respectively of their monthly salaries to a charitable trust. Monthly salaries of A and B are equal and the difference between the donations of A and B is ₹900. If the total donation by A and B is ₹600 more than that of C, then what is the monthly salary (in ₹) of C?

(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 50000.

∴ A's salary = ₹30000

question:
By mistake, the reciprocal of a positive fraction got typed in place of itself, and thereby its value got reduced by 175/4%. What was the value of the fraction?

(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 4/3.

Let the number = a

The reciprocal of the number \(=\frac1a\)

\(a-\frac1a=\frac{175}{400}\)% of a

\(\frac{a^2-1}{a}= \frac{7}{16}\times a\)

16a2 - 16 = 7a2

⇒ 9a2 = 16

⇒ a2 = 16/9 

⇒ a = 4/3

(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 यानी 4/3 है।

माना संख्या  = a

संख्या का व्युत्क्रम  \(=\frac1a\)

\(a-\frac1a=\) a का  \(\frac{175}{400}\)%

\(\frac{a^2-1}{a}= \frac{7}{16}\times a\)

16a2 - 16 = 7a2

⇒ 9a2 = 16

⇒ a2 = 16/9 

⇒ a = 4/3

question:
Some students (only boys and girls) from different schools appeared for an Olympiad exam. 20% of the boys and 15% of the girls failed the exam. The number of boys who passed the exam was 70 more than that of the girls who passed the exam. A total of 90 students failed. Find the number of students that appeared for the exam.

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 500.

20% B + 15% G = 90 ………..(i)

Multiply by (4) eqn(i)
80% B + 60% G = 360
80% B - 85% G =    70 (subtract)
-          +              -
________________________

            145% G =  290

∴ G = 200

Put the value of G in Eqn (i)

20% B + 15% of 200 = 90
20% B = 60 ⇒ B = 300
∴ Total students = 200 + 300 = 500
question_hi:

80%B - 85% G = 70 ……….. (ii)

-           +              -
____________________________

question:
The price of petrol shot up by 5%. Before the hike, the price was 82 per litre. Aman travels 3045 km every month and his car gives a mileage of 15 km per litre. What is the in-crease in the monthly expenditure (to the nearest ₹) on the man's travel due to the hike in the petrol prices?

increase in monthly expenditure = 203 × 4.1 = 832.3 = ~₹832

question:
A man started off a business with a certain capital amount. In the first year, he earned 60% profit and donated 50% of the total capital (initial amount + profit). He followed the same procedure with the remaining capital after the second and the third year. If at the end of the three years, he is left with ₹15,360, what was the initial amount (in ₹) with which the man started his business?

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 30,000.

Let, capital amount = 1000 unit

1st year → 1000×\(\frac{160}{100}\) = 1600 unit

Left → 1600 -\(\frac{1600}{2}\) = 800 unit

2nd year → 800×\(\frac{160}{100}\) = 1280 unit

Left → 1280-\(\frac{1280}{2}\)= 640 unit

3rd year →  640× \(\frac{160}{100}\) = 1024 unit

Left → 1024-\(\frac{1024}{2}\)= 512 unit 

512 unit → ₹15360 

1 unit → ₹30 

∴ Amount = 1000 unit = 1000 × 30 = ₹30000
question_hi:
एक व्यक्ति ने एक निश्चित पूंजी के साथ एक व्यवसाय शुरू किया। पहले वर्ष में, उसने 60% लाभ अर्जित किया और कुल पूंजी (प्रारंभिक राशि + लाभ) का 50% दान कर दिया। उसने दूसरे व तीसरे वर्ष के बाद पूंजी के साथ यही प्रक्रिया अपनाई। यदि तीन वर्षों के अंत में, उसके पास ₹15,360 शेष बचते हैं, तो उस व्यक्ति ने अपना व्यवसाय कितनी प्रारंभिक राशि (₹ में) के साथ शुरू किया था?

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 यानी 30,000 है।

माना, पूंजी राशि = 1000 इकाई

पहला वर्ष → 1000×\(\frac{160}{100}\) = 1600 इकाई

शेष → 1600 -\(\frac{1600}{2}\) = 800 इकाई

दूसरा वर्ष → 800×\(\frac{160}{100}\) = 1280 इकाई

शेष → 1280 -\(\frac{1280}{2}\)= 640 इकाई

तीसरा वर्ष →  640× \(\frac{160}{100}\) = 1024 इकाई

शेष → 1024-\(\frac{1024}{2}\)= 512 इकाई 

512 इकाई → ₹15360 

1 इकाई → ₹30 

∴ राशि = 1000 इकाई = 1000 × 30 = ₹30000

question:
A fruit seller sells 45% of the oranges that he has along with one more orange to a customer. He then sells 20% of the remaining oranges and 2 more oranges to a second customer. He then sells 90% of the now remaining oranges to a third customer and is still left with 5 oranges. How many oranges did the fruit seller have initially?

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 120.

Let the total number of oranges = x 

\(\left\{\left(\frac{x\ \times\ 55}{100}-\ 1\right)\times\frac{80}{100}-\ 2\right\}\times\frac{10}{100} =5\)

\((\frac{x\times55}{100}-1)\times\frac{80}{100}=50+2\)

\((\frac{x\times55}{100}-1)=\frac{52\times10}{8}\)

\(\frac{x\times55}{100}-1 = 65\)

\(\frac{x\times55}{100} = 66\)

\(x=\frac{66\times100}{55}\)

x = 120
question_hi:
एक फल विक्रेता किसी ग्राहक को अपने पास मौजूद कुल संतरों में से 45% और एक संतरा बेचता है। फिर वह शेष संतरों के 20% और 2 संतरे दूसरे ग्राहक को बेचता है। फिर वह बचे हुए संतरों के 90% संतरे तीसरे ग्राहक को बेचता है और उसके पास अभी भी 5 संतरे बच जाते हैं। फल विक्रेता के पास आरंभ में कितने संतरे थे?

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 यानी 120 है।

माना संतरों की कुल संख्या = x

\(\left\{\left(\frac{x\ \times\ 55}{100}-\ 1\right)\times\frac{80}{100}-\ 2\right\}\times\frac{10}{100} =5\)

\((\frac{x\times55}{100}-1)\times\frac{80}{100}=50+2\)

\((\frac{x\times55}{100}-1)=\frac{52\times10}{8}\)

\(\frac{x\times55}{100}-1 = 65\)

\(\frac{x\times55}{100} = 66\)

\(x=\frac{66\times100}{55}\)

x = 120

question:

solution_hi:

question:
The number of units manufactured by a Company A was 12500 units in 2019 and 10625 units in 2020. While in company B, the production fell from 34000 units in 2019 to 30600 units in 2020. If X and Y are the percentage decrease in the number of units manufactured by company A and B, respectively, from 2019 to 2020, then what will be the ratio of X and Y?

(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 3:2.

 \(X= \frac{12500-10625}{12500}\times100\)% \(=\frac{1875}{12500}\times100%\) % = 15%

\(Y = \frac{34000-30600}{34000}\times100\)% \(=\frac{3400}{34000}\times100%\)% = 10%

X : Y = 15 : 10 = 3 : 2

(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution_hi:

\(X= \frac{12500-10625}{12500}\times100\)% \(=\frac{1875}{12500}\times100%\) % = 15%

\(Y = \frac{34000-30600}{34000}\times100\)% \(=\frac{3400}{34000}\times100%\)% = 10%

X : Y = 15 : 10 = 3 : 2

question:
In a factory, 48% of the number of male workers is equal to two-third of the number of female workers. What is the ratio of the number of males to that of the female in the factory?

(CGL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 25:18.

=25 : 18
question_hi:

पुरूष/महिला \( =\frac23\times\frac{100}{48}\)

= 25 : 18

question:
Aditya buys 300 mangoes for ₹1,100. Some of these mangoes are rotten and are thrown away. He sells the remaining mangoes at ₹5 each and makes a profit of ₹150. Find the percentage of mangoes thrown away.

(CGL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. \(16\frac23\).

His selling price = 1100 + 150 = ₹1250

No. of Mangoes sold by him = 1250/5 = 250 

∴ Percentage of mangoes thrown away
\(\Rightarrow \frac{300-250}{300} \times100 \)%

\(=\frac{50}{300}\times100\)%

\(=16\frac23\)%
question_hi:
आदित्य ने ₹1,100 में 300 आम खरीदे। इनमें से कुछ आम सड़े हुए हैं और उन्हें फेंक दिया गया है। वह शेष आमों को ₹5 प्रति आम की दर से बेचता है और ₹150 का लाभ कमाता है। फेंके गए आमों का प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।

(CGL 2023 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 यानी \(16\frac23\) है।

उसका विक्रय मूल्य = 1100 + 150 = ₹1250

उसके द्वारा बेचे गए आमों की संख्या = 1250/5 = 250 

∴ फेंके गए आमों का प्रतिशत
\(\Rightarrow \frac{300-250}{300} \times100 \)%

\(=\frac{50}{300}\times100\)%

\(=16\frac23\)%

question:
Out of the total toffees, 1/10 are wasted. 35% of the rest are given to S and 1/8 of the total are given to N. If the toffees with N are 10 more than the wasted toffees, then how many toffees were given to S?

(CGL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 126.

Total toffee     Wasted 
200                   20

S = \(180 \times\frac{35}{100}=63\)

N = \(200\times\frac18=25\)

Difference between N and wasted = 25-20 = 5 unit 
5 unit → ×2 → 10 toffee
∴ 63 unit → ×2 →126 toffee
question_hi:
कुल टॉफियों में से 1/10 खराब हो जाती हैं। शेष का 35%, S को दिया जाता है और कुल का 1/8 N को दिया जाता है। यदि N के पास मौजूद टॉफियाँ खराब हुई टॉफियों से 10 अधिक हैं, तो S को कितनी टॉफियाँ दी गईं?

(CGL 2023 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 यानी 126 है।

कुल टॉफी      खराब टॉफी       
200                   20

S = \(180 \times\frac{35}{100}=63\)

N = \(200\times\frac18=25\)

N और खराब टॉफी के बीच अंतर  = 25 - 20 = 5 इकाई
5 इकाई→ ×2 → 10 टॉफ़ी
∴ 63 इकाई → ×2 →126 टॉफी

question:
A stock portfolio consists of four stocks. Stock A represents 20% of the portfolio and has a return of 6%. Stock B represents 30% of the portfolio and has a return of 8%. Stock C represents 20% of the portfolio and has a return of 4%. Stock D represents the remaining 30% of the portfolio and has a negative return of 5%. What is the average return of the portfolio? 

(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 2.9%.

A         B         C          D
20%    30%    20%    30% 
6%       8%      4%     -5%
Average return of the portfolio = \(\frac{20\times6+30\times8+20\times4-30\times5}{100}\)%

= \(\frac{290}{100}\)% = 2.9%

(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 यानी 2.9% है।

A         B         C          D
20%    30%    20%    30% 
6%       8%      4%     -5%

पोर्टफोलियो का औसत रिटर्न = \(\frac{20\times6+30\times8+20\times4-30\times5}{100}\)%

= \(\frac{290}{100}\)% = 2.9%

question:

= 20%

इसलिए, परिवर्तन % \(=\frac{18}{90}\times100\)
